title: 情感与评价词汇
goal: 根据事件与行为辨析人物的情感变化。

points.label: 辨析情感评价词的含义
根据事件与行为判断情感变化

body.p: 情感词写的是人物对事件的反应。选哪个情感词、情感怎样变化，要看事件的起因、人物的行动和结果。

body.box: Mia was worried about her missing key. When she found it, she felt relieved.

body.p: 钥匙丢失引起担忧，找到钥匙后担忧消失。relieved 表示担忧解除后的释然。

cards.title: 词汇表：担忧
rows: She was anxious about the delay. / She waited anxiously for news.
He was worried about the storm. / She was nervous before speaking.
He felt uneasy about the noise. / She was concerned about the leak.
She was apprehensive about the journey. / He was fearful of falling.
The sudden smoke left her alarmed. / He was troubled by the mistake.

cards.title: 词汇表：失望
rows: She was disappointed by the cancellation. / He looked sadly at the empty shelf.
He was frustrated by the jammed lock. / She felt discouraged after several failures.
She was upset by the news. / He was unhappy with the delay.
She was dissatisfied with the repair. / He was disheartened by the setback.
He was regretful about his words. / She was sad when the visit ended.

cards.title: 词汇表：释然
rows: She was relieved to find the key. / He felt comfortable once the noise stopped.
安心的 / 得到安慰的
The doctor's explanation left her reassured. / He felt comforted by her words.
She felt calm after hearing the result. / He was relaxed after the long journey.
She was glad the parcel arrived. / He was pleased with the repaired chair.
She was thankful for the help. / He was grateful to his guide.

cards.title: 词汇表：自信
rows: She felt confident after practice. / He spoke confidently after rehearsing.
She was sure of the answer. / He felt assured of their support.
抱有希望的 / 乐观的
She was hopeful about the repair. / He was optimistic about the plan.
She was determined to finish. / He continued determinedly after the delay.
She was proud of her progress. / He appeared self-assured during the talk.

items.stem: The trip was canceled, and Mei felt unhappy because she had looked forward to it. She was ___ .
items.why: looked forward to it 而活动取消，说明她感到失望。

items.stem: Tao feared his bag was lost. When he found it, his worry disappeared. He felt ___.
items.why: 找到包后担忧消失，说明他感到释然。

items.stem: Lena was concerned that she might miss the bus. She waited ___ for it.
items.why: concerned that she might miss the bus 说明她焦虑地等待。

items.stem: After rehearsing, Amir believed he could deliver the speech. He felt ___.
items.why: believed he could deliver the speech 表示练习后的自信。

items.stem: The explanation answered her concerns. Before it she was worried; afterward she was ___.
items.why: answered her concerns 说明解释使她安心。

items.stem: After repeated failures, he felt he might never succeed. He was ___.
items.why: repeated failures 和 might never succeed 表示灰心。

items.stem: Sudden smoke entered the room, and she feared a fire. She was ___.
items.why: sudden smoke 和 feared a fire 表示受到惊吓。

items.stem: Nora thanked the neighbor who helped her carry the bags. She was ___ for the help.
items.why: thanked the neighbor 表示感激帮助。

items.stem: The first repair failed and Jin felt discouraged. After the next attempt worked, she was ___.
items.why: the next attempt worked 说明第二次修好了。Jin 由灰心转为满意，填 pleased。

items.stem: He regretted the unkind words he had said. He felt ___ about them.
items.why: regretted the unkind words 说明他后悔，regretful 就是后悔的。

items.stem: The coach's explanation answered her fears. She became ___ about the exercise.
items.why: answered her fears 说明讲解使她安心。

items.stem: After many attempts, Ali still chose to continue until the work was done. He was ___ to finish.
items.why: chose to continue until the work was done 表示决心完成。

groups.fill: Lia prepared a talk for her class. She was anx{ious} beforehand and wor{ried} that she might forget her notes. Her first practice went badly, leaving her disapp{ointed} and disco{uraged}. Her teacher offered advice, and Lia felt reas{sured} by the explanation. After practicing again, she was more conf{ident} in her preparation and hop{eful} about the talk. When she finished without forgetting, she was reli{eved} that her fear had passed. She was gl{ad} to thank her teacher and pr{oud} of her progress.

items.stem: Jo feared her key was lost, but she found it. Her worry disappeared and she felt ___.
items.why: found it 后 worry disappeared，表示释然。

items.stem: The game was canceled after Tom had eagerly prepared for it. He felt unhappy about the cancellation: he was ___.
items.why: eagerly prepared 说明 Tom 很期待这场比赛。比赛取消，他感到失望。

items.stem: After rehearsing, Mei believed she could perform the song. She now felt ___.
items.why: believed she could perform 表示练习后有信心。

items.stem: Ben feared that the train would leave before he arrived. He waited ___ for news of the delay.
items.why: feared that the train would leave 表示焦虑等待消息。

items.stem: The guide answered Ava's concerns about the route. She felt ___ after hearing the explanation.
items.why: answered Ava's concerns 说明解释消除了担忧。

items.stem: Kai kept working despite setbacks because he had decided firmly to finish. He was ___.
items.why: decided firmly to finish 对应 determined。
